turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Start with why Owen has a zero.
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. And the basis for it?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. People draft in other documents and paste them in, so that proves nothing yet. And under 4.2 you were supposed to call me before any mark went in.
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Show me the outline. With its date, and the essay next to it.
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and it keeps his record clean. But I won't accept a rewrite over an outline I haven't seen.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
I'm not the one being questioned. Owen's outline, Hale. Where is it?
Does he usually work late?
His evenings aren't evidence. Put the outline on the table.
Does anyone help him with his homework?
Not answering that. The outline, and the essay beside it.
You keep not answering me.
You haven't answered me either. Where is the outline?
So the rewrite is agreed?
Nothing is agreed. A rewrite now says he needed one, and I've seen nothing that says so. Ten minutes.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
I'm sure of one thing: I haven't seen the outline. Put it in front of me or tell me you don't have it.
I just want to be clear on the terms.
The zero comes off, in writing, and nothing goes on his record. Until I see the outline, that's all I'm discussing. Otherwise I'm walking to the principal's office from here.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
You heard them the first time. Write them down, and then show me the outline.
And you won't change your mind tonight?
Paper changes my mind, nothing else. I've asked for the outline.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn in writing, nothing placed on Owen's record, and the outline and essay shown to me side by side. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing, nothing on his record, and to see the outline; that is not yet the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), because you never showed the document that would have got her there.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her and moved on, which earned a flat okay, because it answered the procedural wrong she came in angry about.
What cost ground: You pressed her to agree to the rewrite before showing the outline, which made her dig in, because it asked her to accept a remedy without seeing any proof.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night times on October 28, came very close to that night, and she went shorter and harder because of it, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked to see the outline, put it on the table with its date next to the essay before moving on to procedure 4.4.
